newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Little Swan 1996 net up 21.12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Little Swan 1996 net up 21.12 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.7307 yuan vs 1.0136 yuan
Net assets per share 3.67 yuan vs 3.69 yuan
Company name: Wuxi Little Swan Co Ltd.
Note: The results were published in the firm's 1996 annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Monday.
The figures are based on Chinese accounting standards except for net profits which are based on international standards.
Based on Chinese standards, the company posted net profits of 178.48 million yuan in 1996 against 147.19 million in 1995.
The firm's board of directors proposed a cash dividend of 0.51 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, pending approval by shareholders at a meeting on May 28.
Trading in the company's A and B shares was suspended on Monday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
